scope: Isolated foreground policy header; no production runtime hook or IRQ publisher
healthy_contract: External qualified observer supplies nonzero unchanged health generation and exact receipt mask7; checks required before each master step and publication
fault_behavior: Generation change/zero, missing or extra receipts, or any fault revoke gate to FAULT; owner/ticket retained; first error preserved; stale policy cannot poison newer owner; no rebind or automatic recovery
refusal_paths: PROFILE/SETUP/COMPLETE reject before any fake bus or codec sentinel call; sentinel codecs are refusal-only and do not model healthy protocol
mutants: Ignoring generation, ignoring receipts, omitting gate revocation all refused by assertions
limits: Receipts model external obligations, not live network/clock/IRQ detection
Foreground only; no safe ISR publication/synchronization implementation
Does not prevent IRQ nesting or contain faults during an in-flight AXI/decoder/network callback
No GEM reset/recovery suppression, IRQ mask changes or management service hooks; management availability not retested
Actual Rust codec healthy-path composition and A53 execution not tested for this new policy
next: Compose policy into a separate full-setup harness with actual Rust codec, checking health generation before and after each step and before success publication; test late faults without enabling runtime hooks.
